skillsAndPlugins entries declare packages: "skill" and/or "claude-plugin"; repos shipping both appear once with both packages.

categories.title: ABAP & ADT

entries.name: ARC-1 SAP ADT MCP Server
entries.purpose: Secure-by-default, enterprise-ready SAP ABAP MCP server for developer IDEs, Microsoft Copilot, and any MCP client via BTP OAuth and the ADT REST API.
entries.notes: Built for real-world SAP AI workflows: token-efficient tool design, safety profiles and allowlists, per-user principal propagation, OIDC/XSUAA/API key auth, BTP Cloud Foundry and on-prem deployment, npm + Docker distribution, and 1,367+ unit tests plus integration and E2E coverage.

entries.name: ARC-1 LSP ABAP MCP Server
entries.purpose: Expose SAP ABAP MCP tools by delegating ADT operations to SAP's headless adt-ls language server.
entries.notes: Sibling to ARC-1. Bring your own SAP adt-ls binary from ABAP Development Tools for VS Code; focuses on modern ABAP Cloud object coverage with write gates.

entries.name: ARC-1 ADT ABAP MCP Extension
entries.purpose: Extend SAP's Eclipse ADT MCP server with read-only ABAP repository tools and optional auto-login for AI clients.
entries.notes: Eclipse plugin for ADT 3.60+; contributes tools through SAP's documented extension point and relies on SAP's built-in MCP server.

adjacentTools.purpose: Python CLI for SAP ADT and RFC operations: ABAP unit tests, ATC checks, transports, gCTS, abapGit install, and more.

adjacentTools.name: adt-ls TypeScript SDK
adjacentTools.purpose: Provide a reusable TypeScript SDK for driving SAP's headless adt-ls language server from developer tools and CI.
adjacentTools.notes: Bring your own SAP adt-ls binary; used by arc-1-lsp and other ADT/MCP tooling, not an MCP server by itself.

adjacentTools.name: @arc-mcp/xsuaa-auth
adjacentTools.purpose: Drop-in XSUAA OAuth authentication and BTP principal propagation for MCP servers built on Express and the MCP SDK.
adjacentTools.notes: Adjacent library for SAP MCP server authors; provides the MCP-native XSUAA OAuth proxy, stateless dynamic client registration, a chained XSUAA/OIDC/API-key verifier, and a `./btp` principal-propagation layer extracted from ARC-1. Used by ARC-1 and LISA.

adjacentTools.name: arc-mcp-hub
adjacentTools.purpose: Thin, deterministic multi-system MCP hub that fronts multiple ARC-1 instances (one SAP system each) behind one BTP front door with one login.
adjacentTools.notes: Per-environment MCP multiplexer for SAP BTP: an MCP client connects to one `/<env>/mcp` path and the hub routes to that system's ARC-1 with the user's identity preserved (XSUAA login, per-user OAuth2JWTBearer token exchange, SAP principal propagation). No server-side LLM and no merged tool list; connection-scoped routing keeps DEV/QA/PROD isolated. Built on @arc-mcp/xsuaa-auth and the MCP SDK.

adjacentTools.name: SAP MCP Config
adjacentTools.purpose: Provide shared Go and Python models for SAP credentials used by MCP servers.
adjacentTools.notes: Adjacent library for SAP MCP server authors; centralizes credential file parsing, validation, and masking.
